provenance.method: web-verified by a research pass on 19 Sep 2026; official house and parent-company press pages first (Estée Lauder Companies, Kering, LVMH), then dated trade press and reference publishers; extended 19 Sep 2026 (evening) to every designer the catalog credits, from official house/press pages, BoF, WWD and dated trade press
provenance.vogueCoverage: none yet — vogue.com and its regional domains refused the research crawler; the owner's Vogue requirement is OPEN and is recorded per entity as vogueSourceIds (empty until a browser pass adds them)
provenance.fetched: a source with fetched:true was retrieved and read; fetched:false is supported by a dated search result only
provenance.unknownDates: an unknown date stays null with datePrecision unknown; nothing here is guessed
provenance.correction: corrections belong in this file with an updated source, never in a silent edit
